title: Thai-Style Crustacean Stir Fry
description: A keto-friendly Thai-inspired stir fry featuring succulent crustaceans, crunchy vegetables, and a kick of fresh Thai chilies. This dish is quick, easy, and packed with flavor.
instructions: Heat the tum vegetable oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add the Thai chilies and cook for 1-2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the savory sweet onions and cook for 3-4 minutes, until they start to caramelize.
Add the crab meat and cook for 2-3 minutes, until lightly browned.
Stir in the som tum paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the Thai basil and cook for 1 minute, until wilted.
Season with fish sauce (if using) and serve immediately.
Serve with lime wedges on the side.
